_comment: Named run profiles for the migration orchestrator. Each profile defines which MIGRATE_* steps run and which DELETE_* steps run. Credentials/secrets stay in .env; behavior toggles live here. Resolution order at runtime is: defaults (all false) < selected profile < --set CLI overrides.

full-migration.description: End-to-end migration of all supported account configuration (no deletions).

post-user-migration.description: Run AFTER Frontegg Support has migrated your users: adds each user's remaining tenant memberships with their per-tenant roles, then recreates tenant and user API tokens (with NEW clientId/secret).

user-tenant-roles-only.description: Add missing user tenant memberships and per-tenant roles only. Safe to re-run.

api-tokens-only.description: Recreate tenant and user API tokens only. Tokens get NEW clientId/secret values, written to CSV.

roles-only.description: Migrate categories, permissions, and roles only.

delete-cleanup.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete data from the destination account. No migration runs.
